validation: Wine disassembly e202-selector-source-8r_6wz80, e202-constructor-source-amu94h3q, e202-callback-source-enzv4iwu, e202-consumer-source-_tv6i5rb, e202-list-task-source-a7lzqd99 and e202-list-tail-source-g_x2m5fb identify the original dataflow. limitations: The first four row indices follow only if the index starts zero and pointer, count and index remain unchanged.
